title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: American Music Theatre, Lancaster | 2012
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the American Music Theatre in Lancaster, Pennsylvania, USA, on 20 June 2012.

It was the sixth show of the 12th All-Starr Band’s tour of North America, which lasted for 26 dates in June and July 2012.

Starr had previously performed at the American Music Theatre on 6 July 2010. He returned there on 6 October 2026.

The 12th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, harmonica, bass, percussion, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, percussion, keyboards, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums
